title: New welcome screen and smoother motion
notes: Redesigned welcome screen with an animated logo, a side menu and pages for shortcuts, settings, system info and help
Menus and popouts glide in and out more smoothly, with a steadier motion blur
The workspace highlight slides between workspaces
The fastfetch logo keeps its shape
The display manager tool no longer tries to download a theme that does not exist
The arch-cleanup command works again
The dock, power menu and launcher installers download from the Catastrophic repository
The update counter works on Fedora when the folder has matching file names
Removed old helper scripts that pointed to missing downloads

title: Bug fixes
notes: Popouts no longer close when you move quickly between bar items
The dashboard no longer pops open when you sweep past the clock
The bar and the dashboard show the same weather, and it retries if the network is slow at login
The Wi-Fi and Bluetooth tray icons stay hidden behind their chips
Apps no longer show twice when the bottom dock is switched on
Switching the dock on from the sidebar works when it is not running
The update notice and the dashboard agree on whether you are up to date

title: Glass island bar
notes: The bar is three floating glass islands, tinted like the terminal
Your apps and the app grid live in the middle of the bar
Cat workspaces: a paw where windows are open, a cat on the active one
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, volume and battery chips with hover popouts
Menus and the dashboard float as glass cards below the bar
The dashboard opens after resting on the clock, not when sweeping past
Popouts no longer close when moving quickly between bar items

title: Privacy dots and drop-down terminal
notes: A dot in the bar while an app uses the mic, camera or screen sharing
Drop-down terminal on Super + `
Terminals share one kitty process, about 11 MB per extra window
The installer shows what it will change before it starts

title: New top bar and motion blur
notes: Popouts slide out of the top bar
Directional motion blur on moving menus
Terminal transparency is even right to the window edges
Rounder window corners
